scope: L20.attn.hc_pre ops0/1; one die, one invocation

exactness.round_points: Keep each separate FP32 mul/add; no FMA/BF16 conversion of T1/T2.
exactness.binding: Both ops1x5120, same lane/address traversal; T1 remains in that lane.
exactness.preserved_boundary: T2 writes VM. Third mix changes to8x640 and performs original BF16+RED_SUM/REDSQ/REDTREE; unchanged.

ports.chosen_slot: Existing su_s/su_n lane owners; distribute retained words with their existing lane, without new inter-slab data path.
ports.other_slot: Both existing1024bit VM faces retained; aggregate calendar uses1024bits, not summed2048bit bandwidth.
ports.local_bus_note: 32768 bits distributed as32 bits/lane; no32768bit VM corridor. T banks may retain T2 after matching T1 capture until ordered VM drain/ACK.
ports.staging: 32-lane groups filled one per VM beat; two ping-pong packets each with two operand capture masks; full1024-lane packet admitted only when complete. Hold the active pack through capture.
ports.local_bank: 1024 lane banks x5 FP32 words, one read and one write per bank; original packet sequence retained.
ports.local_select: 5:1 per bit; same-lane T1 read for op1, one priced select/capture stage.
ports.coefficient_broadcast: Existing6-stage control/scalar distribution retained; no free broadcast or new cross-lane forwarding.

calendar.basis: Non-overlapped analytical face-serialization envelope; not RTL cycles.
calendar.op0: Baseline readsH0/H1,writesT1; candidate readsH0/H1 and retainsT1.
calendar.op1: Baseline readsH2/T1,writesT2; candidate readsH2 plus laneT1 and writesT2.
calendar.reduction_and_rsqrt: Outside pair; retained at original cost, no zero-filled full-norm price.
calendar.composition_rule: Owner must use same1024bit native baseline AND candidate calendar; do not subtract from an already-fused edge or extrapolate all layers.

storage.validity: Actual complete capture, same command owner, phase/lane/packet index; retain T1 until matching op1 read; outputs publish only after finite VM ACK.
storage.protection: FF staging only; retain existing control/identity protection. Any SRAM substitution must separately include SRAM protection.

area.basis: Gross source-counted estimate; no subtraction from existing12.80594mm2 SU reservation.
area.nand2_basis: ASAP7 TT NAND2x1 footprint only, not SS timing
area.half_allocation: Equalhalf dimensions are reservation illustration, not actual existing lane placement or spare-slot fit.
area.slot_rule: Owner assigns added gross area to existing lane-owner slabs; no existing spare-space assumption, new inter-slab bus or baseline deletion.

adoption_gate.next_owner_action: Maxwell map native-port calendar onto real critical-chain exposure; Einstein review same-lane bank/packet binding; no RTL/build authorized by this model.
